name: Zapper
rootCause: According to an official announcement from DeFi asset management protocol Zapper, its .fi domain was hijacked via social engineering. The current zapper(.fi) page is malicious and should be avoided — users are strongly advised not to click on any related links.

descriptions.text: According to an official announcement from DeFi asset management protocol Zapper, its .fi domain was hijacked via social engineering. The current zapper(.fi) page is malicious and should be avoided — users are strongly advised not to click on any related links.

Zapper’s zapper.fi domain was hijacked on 2025-04-01, exposing users to an unsafe web origin across Ethereum Mainnet, Arbitrum One, Optimism, Polygon Mainnet, and Base. The public record does not confirm any onchain drain or a loss figure. DNS hijack of zapper.fi, apparently through social engineering at the domain infrastructure layer. The available record does not establish the exact registrar or DNS control that changed.
